facts.fact: ICASA published the Draft Amendment to the Radio Frequency Spectrum Regulations, 2015 and the Draft Amendment to the Radio Frequency Spectrum Fees Regulations, 2010 in Government Gazette 54677 on 15 May 2026, and on 7 August 2026 announced hybrid oral public hearings on 19-20 August 2026 at which stakeholders who had submitted written comments could make oral representations.
